codes.name: Pick warriors, then invert the picks
codes.id_text: The number of warriors to pick. The sign of the ID decides whether fallen warriors can be picked (see Options).
codes.options: The sign of the ID works as in Code 14.
codes.label: Pick, then invert the picks
codes.takes: Count 1–6; below 0 lets fallen warriors be picked

codes.name: Clear objects from an area of a map
codes.label: Clear objects from an area of a map

codes.name: Show text
codes.options: The game passes a negative ID on to its text routine unchanged. What it does was not confirmed, so use a positive ID.
codes.label: Show message

codes.name: Battle
ecodes: Battle number (or the lowest of a range)
Highest battle number (0 for a single battle)
Text shown before the battle (0 for none)
codes.label: Ordinary battle

codes.name: Open a shop
codes.options: A zero or negative ID opens the shop window at once, using the number without its sign. A positive ID only makes that shop the current one, so the party reaches it through the shop control while it stays there.
codes.label: Open a shop
codes.takes: Shop number; 0 or below opens the shop window at once

codes.name: Replace a map event's script
ecodes: Map number (-1 for a simple encounter, -2 for a typed encounter)
Branch of the encounter to replace (encounters only)
codes.label: Replace a map event's script

codes.name: Run another map event's steps
codes.id_text: An event number on the current map.
codes.label: Run another event's steps
codes.takes: Event number on this map, 0 to 99

codes.name: Play a sound
codes.options: The game passes a negative ID on to its sound routine unchanged. What it does was not confirmed, so use a positive ID.
codes.label: Play sound
codes.takes: Sound resource ID; below 0 waits for the sound

codes.name: Give treasure
codes.id_text: A treasure number from the scenario's treasure list.
codes.label: Explicit reward

codes.name: Change event chances
ecodes: First event of a range (0 for none)
codes.label: Change event chances

codes.name: Pick warriors
codes.id_text: The number of warriors to pick. The sign of the ID decides whether fallen warriors can be picked (see Options).
codes.options: With a positive ID, only warriors who are up can be picked, and the count is lowered if fewer are available. With a negative ID, the count is its value without the sign and everyone can be picked.
codes.label: Pick party members
codes.takes: Count 1–6; below 0 lets fallen warriors be picked

codes.id_text: 0 allows camping. Any other number forbids it.

ecodes: Battle number, or the first of a range

codes.id_text: The amount, a whole number. It may be negative.

codes.name: Go to the next stage of the mission
codes.id_text: The stage, counted from 1, with a sign. The stage is the ID without its sign: 1 or -1 is the first stage. A positive ID asks the player to confirm. A negative ID goes straight on. Do not use 0, which names no stage.
codes.options: A positive ID first asks a yes or no question. If the player says no, the map is redrawn and the script ends.
codes.label: Stage transition
